title: Lotus Sutra 5
speaker: Zoketsu Norman Fischer
summary: The talk's main teaching is about the importance of humility and respect in spiritual practice, as exemplified by the Bodhisattva Never Disparaging. This bodhisattva's practice of bowing to everyone he met and speaking words of praise and reverence, even to those who were arrogant and powerful, shows that true wisdom and compassion come from a place of humility and recognition of the inherent goodness in all beings. By embracing this approach, we can cultivate a more open and inclusive heart, rather than one marked by arrogance and superiority. This teaching is meant to inspire us to let go of our own ego and pride, and instead, treat others with kindness, respect, and reverence, just as Never Disparaging did.
